Jungle tumble is our preferred play-zone since it is close by, but we have been to a lot of others and I can say this is the best one, mainly because of the congenial and helpful staff. We recently celebrated our Son’s birthday there and it went great and everybody loved it. The play area is big enough for dozens of kids. We also booked À la carte menu, we were pleasantly surprised by the great food quality and service. It has a long menu , much longer compared to  other play zones and everything tasted wow. Do not expect and 5 star restaurant taste but for a play zone it was amazing. Play area had all the facilities including slides ball pit trampolines etc. and as I said earlier all the support staff was very helpful and attentive.
So all in all a great experience and must visit for a quick fun trip or having a birthday party.
